items.title: 巨鎧開發CAPA認證產品 本季起出貨予美大型客戶
items.title_en: Juchai Develops CAPA-Certified Products, Starts Shipping to Major US Customers This Quarter
paras: 面對全球汽車產業和北美售後市場環境快速變化，巨鎧精密-創(2254-TW)今(9)日宣布，正式取得 Certfed Automotve Parts Associaton(CAPA)認證，預計於本季開始出貨予美國大型客戶，另有多項 CAPA 認證產品持續開發中，預計於明年陸續上市。
巨鎧今年前三季合併營收7182萬元，年減83.17%，前三季虧損2.14億元，每股虧損3.35元，恐連虧4年。
巨鎧於去年10 月提出 CAPA 認證申請，並於去年 11 月取得認證證明，顯示公司既有生產與品質體系已具備對接北美售後市場要求的能力。
隨著巨鎧將既有技術優勢延伸至規模更廣泛的汽車售後維修與替換零件市場，巨鎧表示，已陸續取得多件正式的 CAPA 產品認證，本季開始出貨給美國大型客戶，顯示此次布局已從認證與產品開發階段，正式進入實際供貨和營運落地階段。
巨鎧強調， CAPA 認證是公司產品布局多元化的重要一步，相較於過去以北美改裝車燈市場為主要發展方向，將可進一步切入碰撞維修和替換件市場。
目前巨鎧仍有多項 CAPA 認證產品持續開發中，預計於明年陸續完成開發並上市， 基於現有訂單、即將落地的新產品和未來市場拓展，巨鎧預期明年整體營收有望較2025 年成長約 50-60%。
paras_en: Facing rapid changes in the global automotive industry and the North American aftermarket environment, Juchai Precision‑Creation (2254‑TW) announced today (9th) that it has officially obtained the Certified Automotive Parts Association (CAPA) certification and expects to begin shipping to large U.S. customers this quarter. Several other CAPA‑certified products are under development and are expected to be launched gradually next year.

Juchai's combined revenue for the first three quarters of this year was NT$71.82 million, a year‑over‑year decline of 83.17%, and it posted a loss of NT$2.14 billion in the first three quarters, or a loss per share of NT$3.35, potentially facing a fourth consecutive loss year.

Juchai submitted its CAPA certification application in October last year and received the certification in November, demonstrating that its existing manufacturing and quality systems are capable of meeting North American aftermarket requirements.

As Juchai extends its existing technological advantages to the broader automotive aftermarket repair and replacement parts market, the company says it has progressively obtained multiple official CAPA product certifications and will start shipping to major U.S. customers this quarter, indicating that the initiative has moved from the certification and product‑development stage to actual supply and operational rollout.

Juchai emphasizes that CAPA certification is a key step in diversifying its product portfolio; unlike its previous focus on the North American aftermarket lighting market, it will now be able to further penetrate the collision‑repair and replacement‑part markets.

Juchai still has several CAPA‑certified products under development, expected to be completed and launched throughout next year. Based on existing orders, upcoming new products, and future market expansion, the company anticipates overall revenue next year could grow about 50‑60% compared with 2025.

items.title: 傳輝達推進台積電進軍3D DRAM市場  三星、SK海力士無懼逆風大漲3%及5%
items.title_en: NVIDIA Drives TSMC into 3D DRAM Market as Samsung and SK Hynix Rise 3% and 5%
paras: 南韓三星電子與SK海力士股價今(9)日早盤追隨美國晶片股向上反彈，分別上漲3%以及漲逾5%。輝達、超微半導體等美股晶片龍頭股上周五(6日)集體反彈，帶動那斯達克指數收漲1.09%，費城半導體指數收漲4.21%。
反彈催化劑來自政策面。美國總統川普上周五表示，百分之百支持AI，將與希望藉用發展AI慧致富的州合作。
白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特也表示，資料中心建設仍有很大空間，計畫應由當地社區決定，即使節奏放緩，經濟仍有望強勁成長。
企業層面，輝達已接洽阿波羅全球管理公司，打算將後者現有的舊電信大樓，搭建涵蓋20個州的小型資料中心網絡，避開新建審批。
此外，有媒體引述兩名知情人士報導指出，台積電正考慮將業務範圍拓展至先進記憶體晶片製造領域，並已應輝達的要求，開始製定生產3D DRAM的相關計畫。此計畫若是落實，台積電可望進一步擴大自身在AI硬體供應鏈中的影響力。這項動向源自於輝達對先進記憶體晶片供應的需求，反映出AI晶片設計商正積極尋求擴大關鍵零件的供應來源。
paras_en: South Korean stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rose 3% and over 5% in early trading on the 9th, following a rebound in U.S. chip shares. NVIDIA, AMD and other U.S. chip leaders rebounded collectively on Friday the 6th, lifting the Nasdaq index by 1.09% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index by 4.21%.
The rebound was catalyzed by policy. U.S. President Trump said on Friday that he fully supports AI and will partner with states that wish to prosper through AI development.

White House National Economic Council Chair Hastert also said that data‑center construction still has a lot of room, and that plans should be decided by local communities. Even if the pace slows, the economy is still expected to grow strongly.

On the corporate side, NVIDIA has approached Apollo Global Management to build a small data‑center network covering 20 states using Apollo’s existing old telecom building, thereby bypassing new construction approvals.

Additionally, media citing two insiders reported that TSMC is considering expanding into advanced memory chip manufacturing and has begun drafting a plan to produce 3D DRAM at NVIDIA’s request. If implemented, this plan could further expand TSMC’s influence in the AI hardware supply chain, reflecting NVIDIA’s demand for advanced memory chips and the chip designer’s active search for expanded sources of key components.

items.title: 摩根士丹利：美股拋售接近尾聲 未來兩、三周是加倉好時機
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: U.S. Stock Sell-Off Nearing End; Next Two to Three Weeks Are Good for Adding Positions
paras: 數月來投資人對人工智慧（AI）熱潮的不安情緒，在11月2日至6日當周演變為一場全球市場震盪。
上周四（11月5日），大規模拋售引發美股暴跌，令不少投資者措手不及；上周五（11月6日），部分資金重返市場，美股止跌回升，標普500指數收漲0.31%，那斯達克指數漲逾1%，費城半導體指數漲超過4%。
經歷上述波動後，一批華爾街策略師敦促客戶趁機布局。「未來兩到三周，這正是你應該增加風險敞口的地方。」摩根士丹利美國股票首席策略師邁克·威爾遜說道。
上周四拋售之劇烈讓威爾遜等人一樣感到意外。儘管如此，威爾遜仍確信美股有望反彈，並堅持標普500指數年底達到8,000點的目標，這意味著較周五收盤上漲8.4%。
威爾遜和許多華爾街分析師認為，這輪大跌證明標普500指數近幾周賣壓接近尾聲，這不是AI行情崩塌的信號。
「我們確實經歷過一輪AI泡沫，我認為泡沫正在放氣。」亞德尼研究公司首席投資策略師埃德·亞德尼5日在接受媒體採訪時表示。「破裂代表會對經濟產生重大負面影響，但我沒看到這種情況的跡象。」
Seaport Global Holdings首席股票策略師喬納森·戈盧布說，在市場因選舉結果出現小幅調整後就撤離，這不明智。他預估標普500指數年底將收於8,200點。
威爾遜建議投資者買入消費類股票，尤其是在利率和油價繼續下跌的情況下。
亞德尼則看好醫療保健股。亞德尼表示，標普500指數年底目標為7,900點，國會期中選舉後會出現買入機會，目前開始看到一些相當不錯的機會。
雖然標普500指數經歷上周四大跌，但大多數策略師並未動搖。《彭博》匯編的數據顯示，標普500指數年底目標價平均值為7,973點。
paras_en: For months, investors’ unease about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) boom turned into a global market shakeup during the week of November 2‑6.

On Thursday, November 5, a massive sell‑off triggered a sharp drop in U.S. stocks, catching many investors off guard; on Friday, November 6, some capital returned to the market, halting the decline and pushing the S&P 500 up 0.31%, the Nasdaq up more than 1%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up over 4%.

After the volatility, a group of Wall Street strategists urged clients to take advantage of the situation. “In the next two to three weeks, this is exactly the time you should increase your risk exposure,” said Morgan Stanley U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson.

The severity of Thursday’s sell‑off surprised Wilson and others. Nevertheless, Wilson remains confident that U.S. stocks will rebound and maintains a year‑end target of 8,000 points for the S&P 500, which would represent an 8.4% gain from Friday’s close.

Wilson and many Wall Street analysts believe that this round of declines demonstrates that selling pressure on the S&P 500 has been nearing its end in recent weeks, and it is not a signal of an AI market collapse.

“We have indeed gone through an AI bubble, and I think the bubble is deflating,” said Ed Adney, chief investment strategist at Adney Research, in a media interview on the 5th. “A burst would have a significant negative impact on the economy, but I don’t see any signs of that.”

Jonathan Golub, chief equity strategist at Seaport Global Holdings, said it was unwise to exit the market after a slight adjustment following election results. He projects the S&P 500 to close at 8,200 points by year‑end.
Wilson recommends investors buy consumer stocks, especially as rates and oil prices continue to fall.

Adney is bullish on healthcare stocks. He stated that the S&P 500 year‑end target is 7,900 points, and that buying opportunities will arise after the midterm elections, noting that some fairly good opportunities are already emerging.
Although the S&P 500 experienced a sharp drop on Thursday, most strategists remain unshaken. Bloomberg’s compiled data shows the average year‑end price target for the S&P 500 at 7,973 points.

items.title: 歷經震盪洗盤後... 00939躍台股原型ETF績效王 打敗市值型ETF
items.title_en: After a Turbulent Reversal, 00939 Becomes the Top Performing Prototype ETF, Outshining Market-Cap ETFs
paras: ​台股今年行情大起大落，加權指數10/6盤中最高來到49,969點，較去年底上漲約72.5%，隨後卻一路回檔，11/6盤中最低下探37,837點，從高點回落逾24%。攤開今年台股原型ETF績效，漲幅最高的不是市值型ETF，也不是科技ETF，而是主打高股息的統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)。
根據CMoney統計，台股原型 ETF 今年以來報酬率排行榜，統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)以58.5%的成績拿下第一，第二、三名由元大MSCI金融(0055-TW)、富邦旗艦50(009802-TW)分居。其餘依序為富邦淨零ESG50(009809-TW)及兆豐台灣晶圓製造(00913-TW)。
統一00939除了今年以來績效拿下原型ETF第一，最新配息表現也再創新高，本月每受益權單位配發0.15元，刷新掛牌以來紀錄。此外，自成立以來歷次收益分配均順利完成填息，兼顧績效與收益表現，投資人可透過定期定額或定期不定額方式，參與市場長期投資機會。
展望後市，00939基金經理人林良一表示，AI基本面尚未轉弱，加上明年雲端資本支出可望持續擴大，仍為台股提供支撐。不過，融資籌碼仍待消化，後續須觀察龍頭股以外賣壓能否收斂，以及費半能否率先止跌回穩；高息族群評價相對親民，穩定現金流可望持續扮演防禦角色。

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has seen dramatic swings this year, with the weighted index peaking at 49,969 points on the 6th of October, up about 72.5% from the end of last year. It then fell sharply, hitting a mid‑day low of 37,837 points on the 6th of November, a decline of more than 24% from the high. When looking at the performance of prototype ETFs in Taiwan this year, the highest gains were not from market‑cap ETFs or technology ETFs, but from the high‑dividend focused Uni Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW).

According to CMoney’s statistics, the ranking of returns for Taiwan’s prototype ETFs this year places Uni Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) first with a 58.5% return. The second and third places are shared by Yuanta MSCI Financial (0055‑TW) and Fubon Flagship 50 (009802‑TW). The remaining positions are held by Fubon Net‑Zero ESG 50 (009809‑TW) and Mega International Taiwan Wafer Fabrication (00913‑TW).

Uni 00939 not only tops the prototype ETF list this year but also sets a new record for dividend distribution. This month, each unit of the dividend‑eligible share paid 0.15 yuan, the highest since the fund was listed. Since its inception, every dividend distribution has been completed smoothly, balancing performance and income. Investors can participate in long‑term market opportunities through systematic or flexible investment plans.

Looking ahead, fund manager Lin Liang‑yi of 00939 says that the fundamentals of AI have not weakened, and that next year’s cloud capital expenditure is expected to continue expanding, providing support for Taiwan’s market. However, financing positions still need to be absorbed, and it will be necessary to observe whether selling pressure outside the leading stocks can converge, and whether the fee‑half can first stop falling and stabilize. The high‑yield group is relatively attractively priced, and its stable cash flow is expected to continue playing a defensive role.

items.title: 美國防部長赫格塞斯面臨彈劾危機！美國兩黨議員施壓、但川普力挺
items.title_en: U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth Faces Impeachment Crisis! Bipartisan Pressure, Trump Support
paras: 美國眾議院民主黨領袖Hakeem Jeffries公開支持彈劾國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth），直言自己「堅定支持」這項提案。隨著美國期中選舉後，民主黨與部分共和黨議員相繼表態支持，要求赫格塞斯下台的聲浪持續升高，相關彈劾案最快可能於本周提出。
根據《彭博》報導，Jeffries周日（8日）接受《ABC》節目訪問時表示，赫格塞斯濫用職權、削弱美國國家安全，並一手促成魯莽且代價高昂的伊朗戰爭，不僅推升美國民眾的生活成本，也讓美國面臨更大的安全風險。
他指出，眾議院民主黨議員預計周二（10日）首次集會，屆時將討論是否提出彈劾決議案。這也是民主黨在期中選舉拿下國會參眾兩院多數席次後，首次召開會議。
自期中選舉以來，要求赫格塞斯下台的行動在民主、共和兩黨間逐漸升溫。赫格塞斯支持的對伊朗戰爭，也成為共和黨11月3日期中選舉遭遇全面性挫敗的原因之一。
肯塔基州共和黨眾議員Thomas Massie上周表示，眾議院復會後，他「肯定」會重新提出彈劾條款。
Massie在初選中敗給一名獲美國總統川普支持的挑戰者，將因此離開國會。身為川普的長期批評者，Massie曾在對伊朗衝突爆發之初，因赫格塞斯未經國會批准便發動對伊朗戰爭，試圖推動彈劾。
川普曾表示，目前沒有撤換赫格塞斯的計畫，並稱這名國防部長表現「不錯」。
川普周日再次公開肯定赫格塞斯的表現，向佛羅里達州記者表示，赫格塞斯在美國「基本上贏得兩場戰爭」的過程中扮演關鍵角色，所指包括對伊朗的戰爭，以及美軍推翻委內瑞拉總統馬杜洛（Nicolas Maduro）的軍事行動。
川普質疑，既然赫格塞斯是促成這些成果的重要人物之一，為何還有人想彈劾他。
Massie周四暗示，川普應盡快解職赫格塞斯，讓由共和黨掌控的參議院能在民主黨明年1月接掌控制權之前，確認繼任人選。
Jeffries則認為，這項彈劾決議案將獲得「極為強大的支持」，並再次強調：「赫格塞斯必須下台。」
來自阿肯色州的共和黨眾議員French Hill表示，是否撤換赫格塞斯，應由川普決定。
Hill指出，如果赫格塞斯未能妥善執行職務，川普就應考慮更換人選，但他也強調，五角大廈的領導方式是否適當，與赫格塞斯是否犯下足以構成彈劾的違法行為，是兩個截然不同的問題。

paras_en: The Democratic leader of the U.S. House, Hakeem Jeffries, publicly endorsed the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, stating he was "firmly supportive" of the proposal. Following the midterm elections, Democrats and some Republicans have voiced support, raising calls for Hegseth’s resignation, and the impeachment bill could be introduced as early as this week.

According to Bloomberg, Jeffries said on Sunday (the 8th) during an ABC interview that Hegseth abused his authority, weakened U.S. national security, and single-handedly drove the reckless and costly war against Iran, which not only raised the cost of living for Americans but also exposed the country to greater security risks.

He noted that House Democrats plan to hold their first meeting on Tuesday (the 10th) to discuss whether to file an impeachment resolution. This is the first meeting since the Democrats took a majority in both chambers of Congress in the midterms.

Since the midterms, pressure to remove Hegseth has intensified across both parties. Hegseth’s support for the Iran war has also been cited as one of the reasons for the Republican Party’s comprehensive defeat on November 3 during the midterm elections.
Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie said last week that after the House reconvenes, he would "certainly" reintroduce impeachment provisions.

Massie lost a primary to a challenger backed by President Trump and will therefore leave Congress. As a long‑time critic of Trump, Massie had previously tried to push for impeachment when Hegseth launched the Iran war without congressional approval.
Trump has said there are currently no plans to replace Hegseth and has described the defense secretary as having performed "well."

On Sunday, Trump again publicly praised Hegseth’s performance, telling a Florida reporter that Hegseth played a key role in the U.S. "basically winning two wars," referring to the war against Iran and the U.S. military action that overthrew Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.
Trump questioned why, given Hegseth’s role in achieving these outcomes, anyone would want to impeach him.

Massie hinted on Thursday that Trump should remove Hegseth as soon as possible, so that the Republican‑controlled Senate can confirm a successor before the Democrats take control in January next year.
Jeffries believes the impeachment resolution will receive "extremely strong support" and reiterated, "Hegseth must step down."
Arkansas Republican Representative French Hill said whether Hegseth should be removed should be decided by Trump.

Hill pointed out that if Hegseth fails to perform his duties properly, Trump should consider a replacement, but he also stressed that whether Pentagon leadership is appropriate and whether Hegseth has committed wrongdoing sufficient for impeachment are two distinct issues.

items.title: 中國10月CPI攀升0.7% PPI上揚5.7%
items.title_en: China October CPI Rises 0.7% and PPI Climbs 5.7%
paras: 中國國家統計局9日（周一）公布的數據顯示，10月消費者物價指數（CPI）較一年前上升0.7%。
其中，城市上漲0.7%，農村上漲0.7%；食品價格下降2.9%，非食品價格上漲1.5%；消費品價格上漲0.8%，服務價格上漲0.7%。
今年1～10月平均CPI比上年同期上漲0.9%。
與9月相比，10月CPI持平。其中，城市持平，農村下降0.1%；食品價格下降1.0%，非食品價格上漲0.2%；消費品價格下降0.1%，服務價格上漲0.1%。
10月生產者物價指數（全國工業生產者出廠價格，PPI）較去年同期上漲5.7%，較9月上漲0.7%。
工業生產者購進價格較一年前上漲7.9%，較9月上漲1.1%。
今年1～10月平均，PPI比上年同期上漲2.7%，工業生產者購進價格上漲4.0%。
paras_en: China's National Bureau of Statistics released data on Monday the 9th showing that the consumer price index (CPI) for October was up 0.7% from a year earlier.
Both urban and rural CPI increased 0.7%; food prices fell 2.9% while non‑food prices rose 1.5%; consumer goods prices rose 0.8% and service prices rose 0.7%.
For the period January‑October this year, the average CPI was up 0.9% over the same period last year.

Compared with September, October's CPI was unchanged. Urban CPI was flat, while rural CPI fell 0.1%; food prices dropped 1.0%, non‑food prices rose 0.2%; consumer goods prices fell 0.1% and service prices rose 0.1%.
The producer price index (PPI) for October, which measures factory gate prices for industrial output, rose 5.7% year‑on‑year and 0.7% month‑on‑month from September.
Industrial producers' purchase prices were up 7.9% from a year earlier and 1.1% higher than in September.
For the January‑October average this year, the PPI was up 2.7% year‑on‑year and industrial producers' purchase prices rose 4.0%.

items.title: 3.5萬個外掛助攻！DeepSeek AI代理不到3個月衝上154萬日活躍用戶
items.title_en: 3.5 Thousand Plugins Power DeepSeek AI, Surging to 1.54 Million Daily Active Users in Less Than Three Months
paras: 中國 AI 新創 DeepSeek 公布旗下 AI 代理基礎設施的亮眼使用數據，持續透過圍繞開源 AI 技術打造的各類應用程式，挑戰 Anthropic 與 OpenAI。
這家總部位於杭州的新創公司週日於 X 平台透露，旗下開源 AI 代理應用程式 DeepSeek Harness 自 8 月 13 日推出後，不到三個月，截至 11 月 4 日，日活躍用戶已達 154 萬人。
根據連接至自家伺服器的用戶數計算，9 月底、也就是桌面版應用程式推出不久後，日活躍用戶約為 27.1 萬人。
DeepSeek 去年以低成本推理模型 R1 震撼矽谷，如今正搶攻產業下一個戰場：AI 代理基礎設施，讓 AI 能代表使用者自主執行任務。
DeepSeek 計劃推出官方外掛市集，讓開發者發布外掛，供使用者搜尋探索。公司也規劃推出外掛開發者支援計畫，提供詞元（token）補助、技術協助及推廣機會，目前尚未公布進一步細節。
這些新動向反映 AI 產業的競爭重心正在轉移，業者爭取用戶愈來愈仰賴生態系與整合能力，而非僅靠模型效能。
DeepSeek 將 Harness 定位為開放、由開發者驅動的 AI 代理生態系，不僅要在模型效能與成本上挑戰 OpenAI 和 Anthropic，也要比拚圍繞其 AI 技術打造的應用廣度。
隨著 AI 產業從聊天機器人邁向自主代理，DeepSeek 押注第三方應用程式與專業工具能帶動旗下開源 AI 代理基礎設施的普及，並成為對抗矽谷專有技術的關鍵競爭優勢。
AI 代理能在極少的人為監督下，代表使用者執行多步驟任務，例如撰寫及修改程式碼、分析檔案、進行研究，以及使用其他工具。
Harness 的算力需求尤其值得關注。這款應用程式每日消耗約 92 兆個詞元，換算每名活躍用戶每日約使用 6,000 萬個詞元，成為首批顯示 AI 代理大幅推升算力需求的實際數據之一。
這項規模顯示，AI 代理的算力需求遠高於聊天機器人。AI 代理在幾乎無須人為介入的情況下，會連續運作數小時，讀取或撰寫程式碼、使用其他工具及瀏覽網路。
DeepSeek 正以「一切皆為外掛」的架構打造 Harness。外掛可在不更動軟體本身的情況下，為其增添特定功能。
DeepSeek 表示，目前約有 3.5 萬個外掛，且 60% 的用戶至少建立過一個外掛，不過各外掛的複雜程度不一。
paras_en: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has announced impressive usage data for its AI agent infrastructure, continuing to challenge Anthropic and OpenAI with a range of applications built around open‑source AI technology.

The Hangzhou‑based startup revealed on X that its open‑source AI agent app DeepSeek Harness, launched on August 13, had reached 1.54 million daily active users by November 4, less than three months after launch.
Based on the number of users connected to its own servers, the daily active user count was about 271,000 at the end of September, shortly after the desktop app was released.

DeepSeek shocked Silicon Valley last year with its low‑cost inference model R1, and is now targeting the next battleground: AI agent infrastructure that lets AI autonomously perform tasks on behalf of users.

The company plans to launch an official plugin marketplace where developers can publish plugins for users to discover and explore. It also intends to roll out a developer support program offering token subsidies, technical assistance and promotion opportunities, though further details have not yet been disclosed.
These new moves reflect a shift in the AI industry's competitive focus, with firms vying for users who increasingly rely on ecosystems and integration capabilities rather than just model performance.

DeepSeek positions Harness as an open, developer‑driven AI agent ecosystem that not only competes with OpenAI and Anthropic on model performance and cost but also outpaces the breadth of applications built around its AI technology.

As the AI industry moves from chatbots to autonomous agents, DeepSeek bets that third‑party apps and professional tools will drive adoption of its open‑source AI agent infrastructure and become a key competitive advantage against proprietary Silicon Valley tech.
AI agents can perform multi‑step tasks on behalf of users with minimal human supervision, such as writing and editing code, analyzing files, conducting research, and using other tools.

The compute demand of Harness is particularly noteworthy. The app consumes about 92 trillion tokens per day, which translates to roughly 60 million tokens per active user per day, making it one of the first real data points showing how AI agents dramatically increase compute demand.

This scale demonstrates that AI agents require far more compute than chatbots. With almost no human intervention, AI agents run continuously for hours, reading or writing code, using other tools, and browsing the web.
DeepSeek is building Harness around a "everything is a plugin" architecture. Plugins can add specific functionality without modifying the core software.
DeepSeek reports that there are currently about 35 000 plugins, and 60 % of users have created at least one plugin, though the complexity of each plugin varies.

items.title: 大鵬推進零組件替代方案控管成本 明年上半年起分階段導入客戶訂單
items.title_en: Great Power Advances Component Replacement Plans to Control Costs, Phased Implementation from H1 2027
paras: 網通廠大鵬(7689-TW)面對記憶體與關鍵零組件價格上漲及交期拉長等挑戰，大鵬積極攜手客戶推動替代方案並調整安全庫存，儘管低成本庫存用罄使第3季毛利率下滑至21.43%，但目前已就替代方案與客戶達成商務共識並於10月陸續接獲訂單，預計2027年起分兩階段導入以改善成本結構。

大鵬第3季合併營收為新台幣13.01億元、年增百分之4.03，歸屬於母公司業主之淨利為0.96億元，單季每股盈餘1.69元，累計前3季合併營收達42.57億元、年增百分之27.14，歸屬於母公司業主之淨利為4.41億元、與去年同期相當，累計每股盈餘8.11元。針對後續成本結構優化，依公司於10月法人說明會所述規劃，第一階段記憶體及關鍵零組件替代方案目標於2027年上半年陸續導入，第二階段則預計於2027年下半年進一步實施。
剖析供應鏈成本控管與毛利率變化，大鵬在記憶體及關鍵零組件價格上漲初期，主要是以既有庫存支應生產，並同步與相關客戶評估替代方案。然而如同10月法人說明會所述，部分替代方案的後續驗證時間較原先預期更長，影響了新舊方案的切換安排，隨著部分低成本庫存陸續用罄，較高的材料成本便逐步反映在第3季的毛利率表現上。
在新舊方案轉換期間的庫存與接單管理方面，大鵬積極與相關客戶協調現行產品的備貨及交貨安排，並配合新版導入進度調整安全庫存，雖因此影響相關產品的短期拉貨節奏，但目前已順利與客戶就替代方案之商務安排達成共識。公司於10月起已陸續接獲訂單，後續實際導入將配合驗證進度辦理，此項安排兼顧了客戶營運所需的供應穩定與產品轉換進度，有助於降低轉換負擔並維持長期穩定的合作關係。
針對近期出貨排程與供應鏈交期控管，大鵬公布10月自結合併營收為新台幣1.79億元，累計前10月合併營收為44.36億元，10月營收較低主因是部分原訂10月出貨的產品雖已備妥，但受客戶船期安排影響而預計延至11月裝船，相關營收將依實際出貨情形及合約約定條件認列。
此外，另有部分原訂11月及12月交付的新產品，因受到關鍵零組件供應交期延後影響，交貨排程必須配合到料及後續生產時間調整，導致部分交貨可能遞延至明年，公司正持續向供應商爭取可供數量及較早交期，並與客戶密切協調交貨安排。
展望未來營運與產業趨勢，隨著兩階段替代方案在2027年上、下半年逐步到位，大鵬預期將有助於改善目前受原物料成本上升影響的成本結構。不過公司也提醒，實際導入進度仍須視後續驗證情形而定，整體毛利率表現亦將受到原物料價格波動、產品組合及出貨結構等多重因素影響，後續將依實際進度持續向投資人說明。
paras_en: Great Power (7689-TW) faces challenges from rising memory and key component prices and extended lead times; the company is actively partnering with customers to promote replacement solutions and adjust safety stock. Although the low‑cost inventory was depleted, causing Q3 gross margin to fall to 21.43%, the company has reached a business consensus on replacement solutions with customers and has begun receiving orders in October. From 2027, the solutions will be introduced in two phases to improve the cost structure.

Great Power’s Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$1.301 billion, up 4.03% YoY, with net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$96 million and diluted EPS of NT$1.69. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$4.257 billion, up 27.14% YoY, with net profit of NT$441 million, comparable to the same period last year, and cumulative diluted EPS of NT$8.11. To further optimize the cost structure, the company’s October corporate briefing outlined that the first phase of memory and key component replacement targets will be rolled out in H1 2027, with the second phase planned for H2 2027.

Analyzing supply‑chain cost control and margin changes, Great Power initially relied on existing inventory to support production during the early price hikes of memory and key components, while simultaneously evaluating replacement options with relevant customers. As noted in the October briefing, the verification time for some replacement solutions was longer than expected, affecting the switch schedule between old and new solutions. As low‑cost inventory was gradually depleted, higher material costs began to reflect in Q3 gross margin performance.

During the transition between old and new solutions, Great Power actively coordinated with customers on current product stock‑keeping and delivery arrangements, and adjusted safety stock in line with the new implementation schedule. Although this impacted the short‑term pull‑rate of related products, the company has successfully reached a consensus with customers on the business arrangements for replacement solutions. Since October, orders have been received, and actual implementation will proceed in line with verification progress, balancing customers’ operational supply stability and product transition pace, thereby reducing transition burden and maintaining long‑term stable cooperation.

Regarding recent shipment schedules and supply‑chain lead‑time control, Great Power reported October consolidated revenue of NT$179 million, with cumulative revenue for the first ten months at NT$4.436 billion. The lower October revenue was mainly due to some products originally scheduled for October shipment being delayed to November due to customer vessel schedules; the related revenue will be recognized based on actual shipment and contractual terms.

Additionally, some new products originally slated for November and December delivery were delayed due to extended lead times for key component supply, requiring adjustments to material arrival and subsequent production schedules, potentially pushing some deliveries into next year. The company is actively negotiating with suppliers for available quantities and earlier delivery dates, and closely coordinating delivery arrangements with customers.

Looking ahead, as the two‑phase replacement solutions gradually take effect in H1 and H2 2027, Great Power expects to improve the current cost structure impacted by rising raw material costs. However, the company cautions that actual implementation progress will depend on subsequent verification, and overall gross margin performance will be influenced by raw material price fluctuations, product mix, and shipment structure. The company will continue to update investors based on actual progress.

items.title: 巨鎧開發CAPA認證產品 本季起出貨予美大型客戶
items.title_en: Juchai Develops CAPA-Certified Products, Starts Shipping to Major US Customers This Quarter
paras: 面對全球汽車產業和北美售後市場環境快速變化，巨鎧精密-創(2254-TW)今(9)日宣布，正式取得 Certfed Automotve Parts Associaton(CAPA)認證，預計於本季開始出貨予美國大型客戶，另有多項 CAPA 認證產品持續開發中，預計於明年陸續上市。
巨鎧今年前三季合併營收7182萬元，年減83.17%，前三季虧損2.14億元，每股虧損3.35元，恐連虧4年。
巨鎧於去年10 月提出 CAPA 認證申請，並於去年 11 月取得認證證明，顯示公司既有生產與品質體系已具備對接北美售後市場要求的能力。
隨著巨鎧將既有技術優勢延伸至規模更廣泛的汽車售後維修與替換零件市場，巨鎧表示，已陸續取得多件正式的 CAPA 產品認證，本季開始出貨給美國大型客戶，顯示此次布局已從認證與產品開發階段，正式進入實際供貨和營運落地階段。
巨鎧強調， CAPA 認證是公司產品布局多元化的重要一步，相較於過去以北美改裝車燈市場為主要發展方向，將可進一步切入碰撞維修和替換件市場。
目前巨鎧仍有多項 CAPA 認證產品持續開發中，預計於明年陸續完成開發並上市， 基於現有訂單、即將落地的新產品和未來市場拓展，巨鎧預期明年整體營收有望較2025 年成長約 50-60%。
paras_en: Facing rapid changes in the global automotive industry and the North American aftermarket environment, Juchai Precision‑Creation (2254‑TW) announced today (9th) that it has officially obtained the Certified Automotive Parts Association (CAPA) certification and expects to begin shipping to large U.S. customers this quarter. Several other CAPA‑certified products are under development and are expected to be launched gradually next year.

Juchai's combined revenue for the first three quarters of this year was NT$71.82 million, a year‑over‑year decline of 83.17%, and it posted a loss of NT$2.14 billion in the first three quarters, or a loss per share of NT$3.35, potentially facing a fourth consecutive loss year.

Juchai submitted its CAPA certification application in October last year and received the certification in November, demonstrating that its existing manufacturing and quality systems are capable of meeting North American aftermarket requirements.

As Juchai extends its existing technological advantages to the broader automotive aftermarket repair and replacement parts market, the company says it has progressively obtained multiple official CAPA product certifications and will start shipping to major U.S. customers this quarter, indicating that the initiative has moved from the certification and product‑development stage to actual supply and operational rollout.

Juchai emphasizes that CAPA certification is a key step in diversifying its product portfolio; unlike its previous focus on the North American aftermarket lighting market, it will now be able to further penetrate the collision‑repair and replacement‑part markets.

Juchai still has several CAPA‑certified products under development, expected to be completed and launched throughout next year. Based on existing orders, upcoming new products, and future market expansion, the company anticipates overall revenue next year could grow about 50‑60% compared with 2025.

items.title: 傳輝達推進台積電進軍3D DRAM市場  三星、SK海力士無懼逆風大漲3%及5%
items.title_en: NVIDIA Drives TSMC into 3D DRAM Market as Samsung and SK Hynix Rise 3% and 5%
paras: 南韓三星電子與SK海力士股價今(9)日早盤追隨美國晶片股向上反彈，分別上漲3%以及漲逾5%。輝達、超微半導體等美股晶片龍頭股上周五(6日)集體反彈，帶動那斯達克指數收漲1.09%，費城半導體指數收漲4.21%。
反彈催化劑來自政策面。美國總統川普上周五表示，百分之百支持AI，將與希望藉用發展AI慧致富的州合作。
白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特也表示，資料中心建設仍有很大空間，計畫應由當地社區決定，即使節奏放緩，經濟仍有望強勁成長。
企業層面，輝達已接洽阿波羅全球管理公司，打算將後者現有的舊電信大樓，搭建涵蓋20個州的小型資料中心網絡，避開新建審批。
此外，有媒體引述兩名知情人士報導指出，台積電正考慮將業務範圍拓展至先進記憶體晶片製造領域，並已應輝達的要求，開始製定生產3D DRAM的相關計畫。此計畫若是落實，台積電可望進一步擴大自身在AI硬體供應鏈中的影響力。這項動向源自於輝達對先進記憶體晶片供應的需求，反映出AI晶片設計商正積極尋求擴大關鍵零件的供應來源。
paras_en: South Korean stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rose 3% and over 5% in early trading on the 9th, following a rebound in U.S. chip shares. NVIDIA, AMD and other U.S. chip leaders rebounded collectively on Friday the 6th, lifting the Nasdaq index by 1.09% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index by 4.21%.
The rebound was catalyzed by policy. U.S. President Trump said on Friday that he fully supports AI and will partner with states that wish to prosper through AI development.

White House National Economic Council Chair Hastert also said that data‑center construction still has a lot of room, and that plans should be decided by local communities. Even if the pace slows, the economy is still expected to grow strongly.

On the corporate side, NVIDIA has approached Apollo Global Management to build a small data‑center network covering 20 states using Apollo’s existing old telecom building, thereby bypassing new construction approvals.

Additionally, media citing two insiders reported that TSMC is considering expanding into advanced memory chip manufacturing and has begun drafting a plan to produce 3D DRAM at NVIDIA’s request. If implemented, this plan could further expand TSMC’s influence in the AI hardware supply chain, reflecting NVIDIA’s demand for advanced memory chips and the chip designer’s active search for expanded sources of key components.

items.title: 歷經震盪洗盤後... 00939躍台股原型ETF績效王 打敗市值型ETF
items.title_en: After a Turbulent Reversal, 00939 Becomes the Top Performing Prototype ETF, Outshining Market-Cap ETFs
paras: ​台股今年行情大起大落，加權指數10/6盤中最高來到49,969點，較去年底上漲約72.5%，隨後卻一路回檔，11/6盤中最低下探37,837點，從高點回落逾24%。攤開今年台股原型ETF績效，漲幅最高的不是市值型ETF，也不是科技ETF，而是主打高股息的統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)。
根據CMoney統計，台股原型 ETF 今年以來報酬率排行榜，統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)以58.5%的成績拿下第一，第二、三名由元大MSCI金融(0055-TW)、富邦旗艦50(009802-TW)分居。其餘依序為富邦淨零ESG50(009809-TW)及兆豐台灣晶圓製造(00913-TW)。
統一00939除了今年以來績效拿下原型ETF第一，最新配息表現也再創新高，本月每受益權單位配發0.15元，刷新掛牌以來紀錄。此外，自成立以來歷次收益分配均順利完成填息，兼顧績效與收益表現，投資人可透過定期定額或定期不定額方式，參與市場長期投資機會。
展望後市，00939基金經理人林良一表示，AI基本面尚未轉弱，加上明年雲端資本支出可望持續擴大，仍為台股提供支撐。不過，融資籌碼仍待消化，後續須觀察龍頭股以外賣壓能否收斂，以及費半能否率先止跌回穩；高息族群評價相對親民，穩定現金流可望持續扮演防禦角色。

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market has seen dramatic swings this year, with the weighted index peaking at 49,969 points on the 6th of October, up about 72.5% from the end of last year. It then fell sharply, hitting a mid‑day low of 37,837 points on the 6th of November, a decline of more than 24% from the high. When looking at the performance of prototype ETFs in Taiwan this year, the highest gains were not from market‑cap ETFs or technology ETFs, but from the high‑dividend focused Uni Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW).

According to CMoney’s statistics, the ranking of returns for Taiwan’s prototype ETFs this year places Uni Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) first with a 58.5% return. The second and third places are shared by Yuanta MSCI Financial (0055‑TW) and Fubon Flagship 50 (009802‑TW). The remaining positions are held by Fubon Net‑Zero ESG 50 (009809‑TW) and Mega International Taiwan Wafer Fabrication (00913‑TW).

Uni 00939 not only tops the prototype ETF list this year but also sets a new record for dividend distribution. This month, each unit of the dividend‑eligible share paid 0.15 yuan, the highest since the fund was listed. Since its inception, every dividend distribution has been completed smoothly, balancing performance and income. Investors can participate in long‑term market opportunities through systematic or flexible investment plans.

Looking ahead, fund manager Lin Liang‑yi of 00939 says that the fundamentals of AI have not weakened, and that next year’s cloud capital expenditure is expected to continue expanding, providing support for Taiwan’s market. However, financing positions still need to be absorbed, and it will be necessary to observe whether selling pressure outside the leading stocks can converge, and whether the fee‑half can first stop falling and stabilize. The high‑yield group is relatively attractively priced, and its stable cash flow is expected to continue playing a defensive role.

items.title_en: Wah-Tong (2313) Q3 Gross Margin Rises to 21.33%! Satellite and Optical Module Dual Engines, 2027 Revenue Targets One Trillion
paras: 2026年11月9日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 華通產品結構持續轉型，衛星與資料中心業務合計占比已突破三成，逐步降低對手機市場的依賴。
第三季毛利率升至21.33%，mSAP光模組相關產品也將在2027年放量，法人預估全年營收有機會挑戰千億元。
不過，材料缺料、擴產折舊與衛星換代仍是短期變數。

衛星與資料中心占比突破三成，產品組合持續優化
2026年第三季，華通衛星業務占營收22%，資料中心與網通占10%，合計達32%；手機占比則從2024年第四季的21%降至18%，顯示營運重心逐漸轉向非消費性市場。

衛星V3換代，2027年營收可望接近倍增
華通天上衛星板市占率超過九成，V3預計2026年第四季至2027年第一季量產。
法人預期，2027年天上衛星營收有機會接近倍增，衛星業務占比也可望提升至24%至25%。

mSAP光模組放量，成為新獲利引擎
華通2026年mSAP相關營收約20億元，預估2027年有機會提升至250億元，占整體營收20%至25%。
目前光模組訂單需求約為材料供應量的兩倍，瓶頸主要在材料取得，且新設備交期已拉長至約18個月。
隨著新產能自2026年第四季至2027年第二季逐步開出，資料中心業務可望加速成長。

第三季毛利率升至21.33%，擴產也帶來資金壓力
華通第三季營收225.85億元，毛利率21.33%，季增2.82個百分點，EPS為1.8元；10月營收87.83億元，年增24.74%，連續兩個月創高。

不過，大規模投資也將推升折舊成本，後續需觀察新產能利用率與高毛利產品放量速度，能否支撐毛利率持續改善。

paras_en: On November 9, 2026 (Yuan Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) – Wah-Tong’s product mix continues to transform, with satellite and data center businesses together accounting for more than 30% of revenue, gradually reducing dependence on the mobile market.

The Q3 gross margin rose to 21.33%, and mSAP optical module products are also expected to scale up in 2027, with institutional analysts estimating that annual revenue could challenge the one‑trillion‑yuan mark.
However, material shortages, expansion depreciation, and satellite generation changes remain short‑term variables.

Satellite and data center share exceeds 30%, product mix continues to optimize: In Q3 2026, Wah‑Tong’s satellite business accounted for 22% of revenue, data center and network communications 10%, totaling 32%; mobile share fell from 21% in Q4 2024 to 18%, indicating a shift toward non‑consumer markets.
Satellite V3 upgrade, 2027 revenue expected to nearly double: Wah‑Tong’s Tian‑Shang satellite board market share exceeds 90%, with V3 slated for mass production from Q4 2026 to Q1 2027.
Institutional analysts expect Tian‑Shang satellite revenue in 2027 to nearly double, with satellite business share potentially rising to 24%–25%.

mSAP optical module volume growth becomes a new profit engine: Wah‑Tong’s 2026 mSAP‑related revenue is about 2 billion yuan, with a 2027 target of 25 billion yuan, representing 20%–25% of total revenue.
Current optical module order demand is about twice the material supply, with the bottleneck mainly in material procurement, and new equipment lead times have extended to about 18 months.
As new capacity gradually comes online from Q4 2026 to Q2 2027, data center business is expected to accelerate growth.

Q3 gross margin rose to 21.33%, expansion also brings capital pressure: Wah‑Tong’s Q3 revenue was 22.585 billion yuan, gross margin 21.33%, a 2.82‑percentage‑point increase, EPS 1.80 yuan; October revenue 8.783 billion yuan, year‑on‑year 24.74%, a two‑month consecutive high.
To support expansion, the company plans annual capital expenditure of over 20 billion yuan from 2026 to 2028, and has decided to issue 18 billion yuan of unsecured convertible bonds.

However, large‑scale investment will also raise depreciation costs; future observation is needed on new capacity utilization and high‑margin product volume growth to see if gross margin can continue to improve.

items.title: AI晶片龍頭輝達啟動調查黃仁勳承認婚外情、續掌公司
items.title_en: AI Chip Leader Nvidia Launches Investigation, Jensen Huang Admits Affair, Remains at Helm
paras: 2026年11月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片大廠輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)11月8日表示，董事會已啟動獨立調查，釐清創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的目標。黃仁勳同日向員工承認對婚姻不忠並致歉，公司則表示，他將持續領導輝達，營運領導不會中斷。
調查由獨立董事組成的委員會監督，並由外部獨立法律顧問協助。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認定美國國家安全或輝達機密受到損害，但會檢視所有可取得的資訊，並強調對黃仁勳及領導團隊仍有信心。黃仁勳支持調查並承諾配合，同時表示將致力保護公司及支持美國國家安全。
《紐約時報》上月報導，黃仁勳與新加坡公司Megaspeed前主管Alice Huang有密切關係，並稱美國當局調查後認定她與中國情報機構有關。Megaspeed向輝達採購AI晶片，美國當局亦因其涉嫌協助中國取得受出口限制的先進晶片而展開審查。中國外交部及Megaspeed尚未回應置評要求。
美國總統川普8日表示，尚未就相關指控與黃仁勳交談，並肯定他過去的表現。美國眾議院共和黨重要議員則已在11月4日致函黃仁勳，要求本月向國會說明，認為有必要釐清相關報導對美國敏感技術及國家安全的影響。
黃仁勳領導輝達逾30年，是公司發展為AI晶片主要供應商的關鍵人物。Yorkville Ives & Co.分析師Dan Ives認為，黃仁勳對輝達的全球策略至關重要，調查結果可能影響其執行長職位，並加深外界對銷往中國晶片的審視；eToro分析師Josh Gilbert則認為，事件可能壓抑市場情緒，但除非高層人事出現變動，否則不致改變長期前景。

paras_en: On November 8, 2026, AI chip giant NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced that its board has launched an independent investigation to determine whether founder and CEO Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence activities. Huang admitted to infidelity and apologized to employees on the same day, and the company said he will continue to lead Nvidia, with no interruption to operational leadership.

The investigation will be overseen by a committee of independent directors and assisted by external independent legal counsel. The board said there is currently no reason to believe that U.S. national security or Nvidia’s confidential information has been compromised, but it will review all available information and emphasized continued confidence in Huang and the leadership team. Huang supports the probe and pledged cooperation, while also stating he will work to protect the company and support U.S. national security.

The New York Times reported last month that Huang has a close relationship with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and that U.S. authorities, after investigation, concluded she is linked to Chinese intelligence. Megaspeed purchases AI chips from Nvidia, and U.S. officials have also begun a review because of allegations that the firm helped China obtain advanced chips subject to export controls. China’s foreign ministry and Megaspeed have not responded to requests for comment.

U.S. President Donald Trump said on the 8th that he has not yet spoken with Huang about the allegations and affirmed Huang’s past performance. Prominent Republican members of the U.S. House of Representatives sent a letter to Huang on November 4, asking him to brief Congress this month, arguing that it is necessary to clarify the impact of the reports on U.S. sensitive technology and national security.

Huang has led Nvidia for more than 30 years and is a key figure in the company’s rise to become a major AI‑chip supplier. Yorkville Ives & Co. analyst Dan Ives believes Huang’s global strategy is critical to Nvidia and that the investigation’s outcome could affect his CEO role and intensify scrutiny of chip sales to China; eToro analyst Josh Gilbert thinks the episode may dampen market sentiment but, absent senior‑management changes, is unlikely to alter the long‑term outlook.

items.title: 摩根士丹利：美股拋售接近尾聲 未來兩、三周是加倉好時機
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: U.S. Stock Sell-Off Nearing End; Next Two to Three Weeks Are Good for Adding Positions
paras: 數月來投資人對人工智慧（AI）熱潮的不安情緒，在11月2日至6日當周演變為一場全球市場震盪。
上周四（11月5日），大規模拋售引發美股暴跌，令不少投資者措手不及；上周五（11月6日），部分資金重返市場，美股止跌回升，標普500指數收漲0.31%，那斯達克指數漲逾1%，費城半導體指數漲超過4%。
經歷上述波動後，一批華爾街策略師敦促客戶趁機布局。「未來兩到三周，這正是你應該增加風險敞口的地方。」摩根士丹利美國股票首席策略師邁克·威爾遜說道。
上周四拋售之劇烈讓威爾遜等人一樣感到意外。儘管如此，威爾遜仍確信美股有望反彈，並堅持標普500指數年底達到8,000點的目標，這意味著較周五收盤上漲8.4%。
威爾遜和許多華爾街分析師認為，這輪大跌證明標普500指數近幾周賣壓接近尾聲，這不是AI行情崩塌的信號。
「我們確實經歷過一輪AI泡沫，我認為泡沫正在放氣。」亞德尼研究公司首席投資策略師埃德·亞德尼5日在接受媒體採訪時表示。「破裂代表會對經濟產生重大負面影響，但我沒看到這種情況的跡象。」
Seaport Global Holdings首席股票策略師喬納森·戈盧布說，在市場因選舉結果出現小幅調整後就撤離，這不明智。他預估標普500指數年底將收於8,200點。
威爾遜建議投資者買入消費類股票，尤其是在利率和油價繼續下跌的情況下。
亞德尼則看好醫療保健股。亞德尼表示，標普500指數年底目標為7,900點，國會期中選舉後會出現買入機會，目前開始看到一些相當不錯的機會。
雖然標普500指數經歷上周四大跌，但大多數策略師並未動搖。《彭博》匯編的數據顯示，標普500指數年底目標價平均值為7,973點。
paras_en: For months, investors’ unease about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) boom turned into a global market shakeup during the week of November 2‑6.

On Thursday, November 5, a massive sell‑off triggered a sharp drop in U.S. stocks, catching many investors off guard; on Friday, November 6, some capital returned to the market, halting the decline and pushing the S&P 500 up 0.31%, the Nasdaq up more than 1%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up over 4%.

After the volatility, a group of Wall Street strategists urged clients to take advantage of the situation. “In the next two to three weeks, this is exactly the time you should increase your risk exposure,” said Morgan Stanley U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson.

The severity of Thursday’s sell‑off surprised Wilson and others. Nevertheless, Wilson remains confident that U.S. stocks will rebound and maintains a year‑end target of 8,000 points for the S&P 500, which would represent an 8.4% gain from Friday’s close.

Wilson and many Wall Street analysts believe that this round of declines demonstrates that selling pressure on the S&P 500 has been nearing its end in recent weeks, and it is not a signal of an AI market collapse.

“We have indeed gone through an AI bubble, and I think the bubble is deflating,” said Ed Adney, chief investment strategist at Adney Research, in a media interview on the 5th. “A burst would have a significant negative impact on the economy, but I don’t see any signs of that.”

Jonathan Golub, chief equity strategist at Seaport Global Holdings, said it was unwise to exit the market after a slight adjustment following election results. He projects the S&P 500 to close at 8,200 points by year‑end.
Wilson recommends investors buy consumer stocks, especially as rates and oil prices continue to fall.

Adney is bullish on healthcare stocks. He stated that the S&P 500 year‑end target is 7,900 points, and that buying opportunities will arise after the midterm elections, noting that some fairly good opportunities are already emerging.
Although the S&P 500 experienced a sharp drop on Thursday, most strategists remain unshaken. Bloomberg’s compiled data shows the average year‑end price target for the S&P 500 at 7,973 points.

paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 週日(8日)宣布，董事會正調查執行長黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的鎖定目標。輝達發言人表示，調查期間黃仁勳將持續擔任執行長，職務「不受影響」，並強調：「今天的消息不會拖慢輝達的腳步。」
近幾週的報導指出，美國政府正調查黃仁勳與黃樂（Alice Huang）的密切關係，美國官員懷疑後者是中國間諜。Alice Huang 曾任新加坡雲端運算公司 Megaspeed 高層，該公司是輝達的晶片客戶。
《金融時報》週末報導指出，黃仁勳與黃樂並無親屬關係，但兩人關係親密。黃仁勳在週日致員工的信中坦承對妻子不忠。
黃仁勳表示：「我為自己的行為及造成的傷害負起全部責任，也接受隨之而來的批評。」
鑑於輝達在人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮中的核心地位，這起事件為科技產業再添打擊。市場對 AI 支出的可持續性、支撐這些支出的融資，以及部分大型科技公司疲弱業績的疑慮，已讓 AI 股在今年秋季承受沉重賣壓。
Yorkville Ives 分析師丹尼爾·艾夫斯（Daniel Ives）稱此新聞為黃仁勳的「污點時刻」，並認為這將引發美國國會的關切與調查。
艾夫斯指出，根據董事會調查結果，黃仁勳確實面臨被撤換執行長職務的風險；鑑於他在輝達全球戰略與故事論述中的關鍵地位，這將為股價增添不確定性。
伯恩斯坦分析師 Stacy Rasgon則認為，這起事件凸顯輝達的「關鍵人物風險」。一旦黃仁勳「不願或無法繼續領導」，目前「並不清楚誰會、或誰有能力接掌公司」。
輝達聲明表示，雖然公司認為未涉及公司機密或國家安全情事受損，但由獨立董事組成並由外部法務團隊協助的董事會委員會「將審視所有現有資訊」。
Rasgon在報告中寫道，這段關係的「桃色成分」似乎已獲得證實，而「間諜」相關指控目前看來則稍顯薄弱。
例如，市場的一大疑慮是黃樂可能促使輝達執行長向美國政府遊說放寬對華晶片出口限制，但Rasgon指出，輝達多年來一直主張對中國銷售晶片，想必不需要太多鼓動就會這麼做。
Rasgon補充：「整件事至少對形象造成了嚴重傷害。」他與 Ives 均認為，這起事件可能在一段時間內持續籠罩輝達股價。
根據輝達聲明，黃仁勳已承諾配合調查，董事會對黃仁勳及其領導團隊保持信心，並將在適當時機提供進一步更新。
輝達發言人先前曾向《MarketWatch》表示，Megaspeed 與許多其他區域雲端客戶並無二致，高管間的互動屬正常範圍。然而，公司週日發布的聲明與先前對該關係的說法顯有矛盾。
《紐約時報》上個月底對 Megaspeed 的報導，突顯了儘管美國嚴格限制將先進晶片銷售予在華運營的實體，但要阻止輝達晶片流入中國仍面臨廣泛挑戰。
Ives對此表示，最新發展可能「大幅加強對中國晶片銷售的審查，而這仍是華府角力的關鍵議題」。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced on Sunday (8th) that its board is investigating whether CEO Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations. A NVIDIA spokesperson said that during the investigation Huang will continue to serve as CEO, with his position "unaffected," and emphasized that "today’s news will not slow NVIDIA’s pace."

Recent reports have suggested that the U.S. government is probing the close relationship between Jensen Huang and Alice Huang, with U.S. officials suspecting the latter of being a Chinese spy. Alice Huang previously held senior roles at Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed, a customer of NVIDIA’s chips.

The Financial Times reported over the weekend that Jensen Huang and Alice Huang are not related by blood, but they are close. In a letter to employees on Sunday, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife.
Huang stated, "I take full responsibility for my actions and the harm caused, and I accept the ensuing criticism."

Given NVIDIA’s central role in the AI investment boom, this incident adds another blow to the tech industry. Concerns about the sustainability of AI spending, the financing that supports it, and the weak earnings of some large tech firms have already weighed heavily on AI stocks this fall.
Daniel Ives of Yorkville Ives called the news a "blemish moment" for Jensen Huang and believes it will trigger congressional concern and investigation.

Ives noted that, depending on the board’s findings, Huang could indeed face the risk of being removed as CEO. Given his pivotal role in NVIDIA’s global strategy and narrative, this would add uncertainty to the stock price.

Stacy Rasgon of Bernstein highlighted that the incident underscores NVIDIA’s "key person risk." If Huang "does not wish or cannot continue to lead," it is currently unclear who would or could take over the company.

NVIDIA’s statement said that while the company believes no company secrets or national security matters have been compromised, a board committee composed of independent directors and assisted by an external legal team will "review all existing information."
Rasgon wrote in the report that the relationship’s "salacious" aspect appears to have been confirmed, while the "spy" allegations seem somewhat weak at present.

For example, a major market concern is that Alice Huang might have encouraged NVIDIA’s CEO to lobby the U.S. government to ease export restrictions on chips to China. Rasgon pointed out that NVIDIA has long advocated selling chips to China, and it likely would do so without much prompting.
Rasgon added, "The whole affair has at least severely damaged the image." Both he and Ives agree that the incident may continue to shadow NVIDIA’s stock for some time.

According to NVIDIA’s statement, Huang has pledged to cooperate with the investigation. The board remains confident in Huang and his leadership team and will provide further updates at an appropriate time.

A NVIDIA spokesperson had previously told MarketWatch that Megaspeed and many other regional cloud customers are no different, and that executive interactions are within normal bounds. However, the company’s statement released on Sunday appears to contradict earlier remarks about the relationship.

A New York Times report at the end of last month on Megaspeed highlighted that, despite strict U.S. limits on selling advanced chips to entities operating in China, preventing NVIDIA chips from flowing into China remains a widespread challenge.
Ives said the latest development could "significantly increase scrutiny of Chinese chip sales, and this remains a key issue in Washington’s power struggle."

議員在11月4日的信函中表示，這篇報導引發「中國取得美國敏感技術與資訊的重大國家安全疑慮」，並指出：「國會必須釐清美國國家安全究竟受到多大程度的威脅。」
美國自2022年起實施出口管制，試圖限制中國取得輝達先進晶片，以及製造這些晶片所需的設備。黃仁勳則表示，自己「致力於保護輝達，並支持美國國家安全」。
輝達先前曾表示，黃仁勳每年與「數千名客戶高層」交流，而亞洲雲端服務客戶取得的僅是一般商業資訊，不涉及輝達敏感營業秘密，也不包含任何與美國國家安全相關的資訊。
Yorkville Ives & Co. 合夥人暨董事總經理 Dan Ives 表示：「顯然，董事會調查結果可能導致黃仁勳遭到解除執行長職務的風險。由於他對輝達的全球發展及策略至關重要，這也將增加該公司股票的風險。」
Ives 指出：「這對黃仁勳而言無疑是一次重大打擊，至少將引發多項國會調查，也會使輝達股價持續承受壓力。」他並補充，這項消息也將使外界大幅提高對輝達向中國銷售晶片的審查力度。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced on Sunday (8th) that it will conduct an independent investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence infiltration. Earlier, the New York Times reported that Huang had a close relationship with a Chinese businesswoman, former senior executive of Singapore cloud computing company Megaspeed, Alice Huang, who has been identified by U.S. authorities as a Chinese intelligence asset, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the flow of advanced chips to China.

According to Reuters, the New York Times last month reported that Huang had a close relationship with Alice Huang. She had worked for Megaspeed, and after investigation by U.S. authorities she was identified as a Chinese intelligence asset. Megaspeed is a NVIDIA customer in Singapore.

In a message to employees, Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and said he was willing to take "full responsibility" for his actions. NVIDIA stated that Huang has pledged to continue leading the company and will not step down.
Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife and said, "My actions have hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did, and I am deeply sorry."

In a message to colleagues, the board, partners and shareholders, Huang said, "My responsibility is to serve you and to be someone you can trust. I have failed to fulfill that responsibility. I will devote myself fully to NVIDIA and work to regain your trust."

NVIDIA said, "In light of recent reports that the founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been a target of foreign intelligence infiltration, the board is launching an independent investigation. The investigation will be overseen by a committee of independent directors and assisted by external independent legal counsel."

The company said on Sunday that the board currently has no reason to believe that U.S. national security or NVIDIA secrets have been compromised, but the investigation will review all available information. NVIDIA added that Huang fully supports the review and has pledged to cooperate with the investigation.

The investigation adds further pressure on NVIDIA. Current investors have reduced their holdings due to uncertainty about whether AI market growth will continue, and NVIDIA is one of the leading companies in the AI industry. The $4.5 trillion market‑cap chipmaker has seen its year‑to‑date gains fully retrace amid a broader sell‑off in tech stocks triggered by concerns about the sustainability of the AI industry.

U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio was asked by reporters about the Huang incident on Sunday evening and declined to comment. However, senior Republican members of the U.S. House of Representatives have previously asked Huang to testify before Congress this month regarding the New York Times report.

The representatives wrote in a letter on November 4 that the report has raised "significant national security concerns about China obtaining U.S. sensitive technology and information," and noted, "Congress must clarify the extent to which U.S. national security is threatened."

The U.S. has imposed export controls since 2022 to limit China’s access to NVIDIA’s advanced chips and the equipment needed to manufacture them. Huang said he is "committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting U.S. national security."

NVIDIA previously stated that Huang engages with "thousands of senior customers" each year, and that the information obtained by Asian cloud service customers is only general commercial information, not involving NVIDIA’s sensitive trade secrets or any information related to U.S. national security.

Dan Ives, partner and managing director of Yorkville Ives & Co., said, "Clearly, the board investigation could lead to Huang being removed as CEO. Because he is critical to NVIDIA’s global development and strategy, this would increase the risk to the company’s stock."

Ives added, "This will undoubtedly be a major blow to Huang, at least triggering multiple congressional investigations, and will continue to put pressure on NVIDIA’s stock price. It will also significantly raise scrutiny of NVIDIA’s sales of chips to China."

items.title: 華爾街高喊「抄底」！美股暴跌逾3兆美元反成買點？
items.title_en: Wall Street Shouts "Bottom‑Buying"! US Stocks Plunge Over $3 Trillion, Turning into a Buying Opportunity?
paras: 美國期中選舉結果引發美股劇烈震盪，科技股遭遇重挫，但華爾街多位策略師並未因此轉趨悲觀，反而認為這波賣壓可能提供逢低布局機會。摩根士丹利、高盛及Yardeni Research等機構仍看好美股年底前走勢，部分分析師甚至認為，未來幾周正是投資人加碼股票的時機。
標普500指數上周四（5日）單日重挫4.4%，那斯達克100指數更暴跌6.4%，美股市值一天蒸發逾3兆美元。
市場主要擔憂民主黨在美國參眾兩院及多個州長選舉中全面勝出後，可能推動更嚴格的資料中心監管，甚至限制相關建設，進而衝擊AI基礎設施投資。
上周五（6日）標普500指數小幅反彈0.3%，但自上周二選舉結果出爐以來，累計跌幅仍達2.5%。
根據《彭博》報導，摩根士丹利首席美國股票策略師Mike Wilson認為，未來2至3周將是投資人增加股票部位的時機，並維持標普500指數年底目標價8,000點不變。以周五收盤水準計算，這代表指數仍有約8.4%的上漲空間。
Yardeni Research首席投資策略師Ed Yardeni也將這波跌勢定調為市場修正，而非泡沫破裂，維持年底標普500指數7,900點的目標價。

選舉結果衝擊超出預期 華爾街仍看好年底行情

這波拋售的劇烈程度令華爾街多數交易團隊措手不及。選舉結果於上周三（4日）公布後，標普500指數一度上漲1.6%，當時多家金融機構仍建議客戶逢低買進。
高盛股票及衍生性商品策略主管Scott Rubner上周三在客戶報告中指出，投資人仍有相當大的空間重新建立風險部位。隨著不確定性消退，以及市場主要買方陸續回歸，美股年底前最可能的走勢仍是向上。
不過，隔日市場情緒迅速反轉。上周四標普500指數市值單日蒸發逾3兆美元，跌勢遠超市場原先預期。
儘管如此，華爾街多數策略師並未因此改變看多立場。根據《彭博》彙整數據，主要金融機構對標普500指數年底目標價的平均預測為7,973點。
Seaport Global Holdings首席股票策略師Jonathan Golub更將年底目標價設在8,200點，是主要機構中最樂觀的預測之一。他認為，投資人不應因市場針對選舉結果進行小幅修正，就急著退出股市，並明確表態目前仍是買進方。
Yardeni則指出，AI市場確實存在泡沫，但目前更像是泡沫逐步消退，而非突然破裂。他認為，真正的泡沫破裂應對整體經濟造成重大負面衝擊，目前並不認為這種情況會發生。
Yardeni也表示，自己原先就預期選舉後會出現買進機會，如今市場已開始浮現不錯的布局標的。

半導體指數距高點跌逾三成 AI投資前景成關鍵

這波美股修正的核心，仍在於市場重新評估AI投資前景。費城半導體指數上周四單日重挫12%，較6月高點累計下跌36%。
富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon指出，半導體及AI基礎設施類股今年以來一直是推動市場上漲的重要力量，但短期內可能持續承壓。若美股要從目前水準進一步走高，仍需要高貝塔值股票帶動行情。
Kwon將標普500指數年底目標價設在7,700點，在主要機構中相對保守。
不過，他也認為，如果市場持續擔憂AI投資縮減，Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 等科技巨頭反而可能受惠。原因在於，市場預期這些企業可能被迫削減資本支出，進而改善獲利預期。
Kwon表示：「我們不想在這裡過度看空。」
整體而言，華爾街多數策略師仍將這波跌勢視為近期市場修正，而非美股長達四年的多頭行情即將結束。不過，標普500指數能否在年底前重拾漲勢，仍取決於AI交易能否恢復動能，以及政策變化是否真的衝擊AI基礎設施投資。
paras_en: The results of the U.S. midterm elections triggered a sharp shake‑up in the U.S. stock market, with technology stocks taking a heavy hit, yet many Wall Street strategists did not become pessimistic. Instead, they see this selling pressure as an opportunity to build positions at lower prices. Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs and Yardeni Research, among others, remain bullish on the U.S. market through year‑end, and some analysts even say the coming weeks are the best time for investors to add to their equity holdings.
The S&P 500 fell 4.4% on Thursday (May 5), while the Nasdaq 100 plunged 6.4%, wiping out more than $3 trillion in U.S. market value in a single day.

The market is mainly worried that a full Democratic sweep of the U.S. House, Senate and several gubernatorial races could lead to stricter data center regulation, or even restrictions on related construction, thereby hitting AI infrastructure investment.
On Friday (May 6), the S&P 500 rebounded slightly 0.3%, but since the election results were announced on Tuesday, the cumulative decline remains 2.5%.

According to Bloomberg, Morgan Stanley’s chief U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson believes the next two to three weeks are the time for investors to increase equity positions, and he keeps the S&P 500 year‑end target at 8,000 points. Using Friday’s closing level, this implies about 8.4% upside potential.
Yardeni Research’s chief investment strategist Ed Yardeni also labels this sell‑off as a market correction rather than a bubble burst, maintaining a year‑end target of 7,900 points for the S&P 500.

The sell‑off was more severe than expected, yet Wall Street remains optimistic about year‑end performance. The sharp decline surprised most trading teams. After the election results were announced on Wednesday (May 4), the S&P 500 briefly rose 1.6%, and many financial institutions still advised clients to buy on dips.

Goldman Sachs’ head of equity and derivatives strategy Scott Rubner noted in a client report on Wednesday that investors still have significant room to rebuild risk positions. As uncertainty fades and major buyers return, the most likely direction for the U.S. market before year‑end remains upward.
However, the next day sentiment flipped quickly. On Thursday, the S&P 500’s market value fell over $3 trillion in a single day, a decline far exceeding initial expectations.
Despite this, most Wall Street strategists did not change their bullish stance. Bloomberg’s aggregated data shows the average year‑end target for the S&P 500 among major institutions is 7,973 points.

Seaport Global Holdings’ chief equity strategist Jonathan Golub set a year‑end target of 8,200 points, one of the most optimistic among major firms. He believes investors should not exit the market over a small correction tied to election results, and he clearly states that buying is still the way forward.

Yardeni points out that while the AI market does have a bubble, it is more of a gradual unwinding than a sudden collapse. He believes a true bubble burst would have a significant negative impact on the overall economy, and he does not foresee that happening.
Yardeni also says he had already expected buying opportunities after the election, and now the market is showing good candidates for building positions.

The core of this U.S. market correction remains the market’s reassessment of AI investment prospects. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 12% on Thursday, and has dropped 36% from its June high.

Wells Fargo’s chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon noted that semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks have been a key driver of market gains this year, but may face continued pressure in the short term. For the U.S. market to rise further from its current level, high‑beta stocks would need to drive the rally.
Kwon set a year‑end target of 7,700 points for the S&P 500, relatively conservative among major firms.

However, he also believes that if the market continues to worry about a contraction in AI investment, tech giants like Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) could actually benefit. The reasoning is that the market expects these companies to cut capital expenditures, thereby improving earnings expectations.
Kwon says, "We don’t want to be overly bearish here."

Overall, most Wall Street strategists still view this sell‑off as a short‑term market correction rather than the end of a four‑year bullish run in the U.S. market. Whether the S&P 500 can regain momentum before year‑end still depends on whether AI trading can recover its momentum and whether policy changes truly impact AI infrastructure investment.

items.title: AI晶片龍頭輝達啟動調查黃仁勳承認婚外情、續掌公司
items.title_en: AI Chip Leader Nvidia Launches Investigation, Jensen Huang Admits Affair, Remains at Helm
paras: 2026年11月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片大廠輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)11月8日表示，董事會已啟動獨立調查，釐清創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳是否成為外國情報行動的目標。黃仁勳同日向員工承認對婚姻不忠並致歉，公司則表示，他將持續領導輝達，營運領導不會中斷。
調查由獨立董事組成的委員會監督，並由外部獨立法律顧問協助。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認定美國國家安全或輝達機密受到損害，但會檢視所有可取得的資訊，並強調對黃仁勳及領導團隊仍有信心。黃仁勳支持調查並承諾配合，同時表示將致力保護公司及支持美國國家安全。
《紐約時報》上月報導，黃仁勳與新加坡公司Megaspeed前主管Alice Huang有密切關係，並稱美國當局調查後認定她與中國情報機構有關。Megaspeed向輝達採購AI晶片，美國當局亦因其涉嫌協助中國取得受出口限制的先進晶片而展開審查。中國外交部及Megaspeed尚未回應置評要求。
美國總統川普8日表示，尚未就相關指控與黃仁勳交談，並肯定他過去的表現。美國眾議院共和黨重要議員則已在11月4日致函黃仁勳，要求本月向國會說明，認為有必要釐清相關報導對美國敏感技術及國家安全的影響。
黃仁勳領導輝達逾30年，是公司發展為AI晶片主要供應商的關鍵人物。Yorkville Ives & Co.分析師Dan Ives認為，黃仁勳對輝達的全球策略至關重要，調查結果可能影響其執行長職位，並加深外界對銷往中國晶片的審視；eToro分析師Josh Gilbert則認為，事件可能壓抑市場情緒，但除非高層人事出現變動，否則不致改變長期前景。

paras_en: On November 8, 2026, AI chip giant NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced that its board has launched an independent investigation to determine whether founder and CEO Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence activities. Huang admitted to infidelity and apologized to employees on the same day, and the company said he will continue to lead Nvidia, with no interruption to operational leadership.

The investigation will be overseen by a committee of independent directors and assisted by external independent legal counsel. The board said there is currently no reason to believe that U.S. national security or Nvidia’s confidential information has been compromised, but it will review all available information and emphasized continued confidence in Huang and the leadership team. Huang supports the probe and pledged cooperation, while also stating he will work to protect the company and support U.S. national security.

The New York Times reported last month that Huang has a close relationship with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, and that U.S. authorities, after investigation, concluded she is linked to Chinese intelligence. Megaspeed purchases AI chips from Nvidia, and U.S. officials have also begun a review because of allegations that the firm helped China obtain advanced chips subject to export controls. China’s foreign ministry and Megaspeed have not responded to requests for comment.

U.S. President Donald Trump said on the 8th that he has not yet spoken with Huang about the allegations and affirmed Huang’s past performance. Prominent Republican members of the U.S. House of Representatives sent a letter to Huang on November 4, asking him to brief Congress this month, arguing that it is necessary to clarify the impact of the reports on U.S. sensitive technology and national security.

Huang has led Nvidia for more than 30 years and is a key figure in the company’s rise to become a major AI‑chip supplier. Yorkville Ives & Co. analyst Dan Ives believes Huang’s global strategy is critical to Nvidia and that the investigation’s outcome could affect his CEO role and intensify scrutiny of chip sales to China; eToro analyst Josh Gilbert thinks the episode may dampen market sentiment but, absent senior‑management changes, is unlikely to alter the long‑term outlook.

items.title: 傳輝達推進台積電進軍3D DRAM市場  三星、SK海力士無懼逆風大漲3%及5%
items.title_en: NVIDIA Drives TSMC into 3D DRAM Market as Samsung and SK Hynix Rise 3% and 5%
paras: 南韓三星電子與SK海力士股價今(9)日早盤追隨美國晶片股向上反彈，分別上漲3%以及漲逾5%。輝達、超微半導體等美股晶片龍頭股上周五(6日)集體反彈，帶動那斯達克指數收漲1.09%，費城半導體指數收漲4.21%。
反彈催化劑來自政策面。美國總統川普上周五表示，百分之百支持AI，將與希望藉用發展AI慧致富的州合作。
白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特也表示，資料中心建設仍有很大空間，計畫應由當地社區決定，即使節奏放緩，經濟仍有望強勁成長。
企業層面，輝達已接洽阿波羅全球管理公司，打算將後者現有的舊電信大樓，搭建涵蓋20個州的小型資料中心網絡，避開新建審批。
此外，有媒體引述兩名知情人士報導指出，台積電正考慮將業務範圍拓展至先進記憶體晶片製造領域，並已應輝達的要求，開始製定生產3D DRAM的相關計畫。此計畫若是落實，台積電可望進一步擴大自身在AI硬體供應鏈中的影響力。這項動向源自於輝達對先進記憶體晶片供應的需求，反映出AI晶片設計商正積極尋求擴大關鍵零件的供應來源。
paras_en: South Korean stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix rose 3% and over 5% in early trading on the 9th, following a rebound in U.S. chip shares. NVIDIA, AMD and other U.S. chip leaders rebounded collectively on Friday the 6th, lifting the Nasdaq index by 1.09% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index by 4.21%.
The rebound was catalyzed by policy. U.S. President Trump said on Friday that he fully supports AI and will partner with states that wish to prosper through AI development.

White House National Economic Council Chair Hastert also said that data‑center construction still has a lot of room, and that plans should be decided by local communities. Even if the pace slows, the economy is still expected to grow strongly.

On the corporate side, NVIDIA has approached Apollo Global Management to build a small data‑center network covering 20 states using Apollo’s existing old telecom building, thereby bypassing new construction approvals.

Additionally, media citing two insiders reported that TSMC is considering expanding into advanced memory chip manufacturing and has begun drafting a plan to produce 3D DRAM at NVIDIA’s request. If implemented, this plan could further expand TSMC’s influence in the AI hardware supply chain, reflecting NVIDIA’s demand for advanced memory chips and the chip designer’s active search for expanded sources of key components.

items.title: 摩根士丹利：美股拋售接近尾聲 未來兩、三周是加倉好時機
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: U.S. Stock Sell-Off Nearing End; Next Two to Three Weeks Are Good for Adding Positions
paras: 數月來投資人對人工智慧（AI）熱潮的不安情緒，在11月2日至6日當周演變為一場全球市場震盪。
上周四（11月5日），大規模拋售引發美股暴跌，令不少投資者措手不及；上周五（11月6日），部分資金重返市場，美股止跌回升，標普500指數收漲0.31%，那斯達克指數漲逾1%，費城半導體指數漲超過4%。
經歷上述波動後，一批華爾街策略師敦促客戶趁機布局。「未來兩到三周，這正是你應該增加風險敞口的地方。」摩根士丹利美國股票首席策略師邁克·威爾遜說道。
上周四拋售之劇烈讓威爾遜等人一樣感到意外。儘管如此，威爾遜仍確信美股有望反彈，並堅持標普500指數年底達到8,000點的目標，這意味著較周五收盤上漲8.4%。
威爾遜和許多華爾街分析師認為，這輪大跌證明標普500指數近幾周賣壓接近尾聲，這不是AI行情崩塌的信號。
「我們確實經歷過一輪AI泡沫，我認為泡沫正在放氣。」亞德尼研究公司首席投資策略師埃德·亞德尼5日在接受媒體採訪時表示。「破裂代表會對經濟產生重大負面影響，但我沒看到這種情況的跡象。」
Seaport Global Holdings首席股票策略師喬納森·戈盧布說，在市場因選舉結果出現小幅調整後就撤離，這不明智。他預估標普500指數年底將收於8,200點。
威爾遜建議投資者買入消費類股票，尤其是在利率和油價繼續下跌的情況下。
亞德尼則看好醫療保健股。亞德尼表示，標普500指數年底目標為7,900點，國會期中選舉後會出現買入機會，目前開始看到一些相當不錯的機會。
雖然標普500指數經歷上周四大跌，但大多數策略師並未動搖。《彭博》匯編的數據顯示，標普500指數年底目標價平均值為7,973點。
paras_en: For months, investors’ unease about the artificial‑intelligence (AI) boom turned into a global market shakeup during the week of November 2‑6.

On Thursday, November 5, a massive sell‑off triggered a sharp drop in U.S. stocks, catching many investors off guard; on Friday, November 6, some capital returned to the market, halting the decline and pushing the S&P 500 up 0.31%, the Nasdaq up more than 1%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index up over 4%.

After the volatility, a group of Wall Street strategists urged clients to take advantage of the situation. “In the next two to three weeks, this is exactly the time you should increase your risk exposure,” said Morgan Stanley U.S. equity strategist Mike Wilson.

The severity of Thursday’s sell‑off surprised Wilson and others. Nevertheless, Wilson remains confident that U.S. stocks will rebound and maintains a year‑end target of 8,000 points for the S&P 500, which would represent an 8.4% gain from Friday’s close.

Wilson and many Wall Street analysts believe that this round of declines demonstrates that selling pressure on the S&P 500 has been nearing its end in recent weeks, and it is not a signal of an AI market collapse.

“We have indeed gone through an AI bubble, and I think the bubble is deflating,” said Ed Adney, chief investment strategist at Adney Research, in a media interview on the 5th. “A burst would have a significant negative impact on the economy, but I don’t see any signs of that.”

Jonathan Golub, chief equity strategist at Seaport Global Holdings, said it was unwise to exit the market after a slight adjustment following election results. He projects the S&P 500 to close at 8,200 points by year‑end.
Wilson recommends investors buy consumer stocks, especially as rates and oil prices continue to fall.

Adney is bullish on healthcare stocks. He stated that the S&P 500 year‑end target is 7,900 points, and that buying opportunities will arise after the midterm elections, noting that some fairly good opportunities are already emerging.
Although the S&P 500 experienced a sharp drop on Thursday, most strategists remain unshaken. Bloomberg’s compiled data shows the average year‑end price target for the S&P 500 at 7,973 points.

items.title: 美國防部長赫格塞斯面臨彈劾危機！美國兩黨議員施壓、但川普力挺
items.title_en: U.S. Defense Secretary Hegseth Faces Impeachment Crisis! Bipartisan Pressure, Trump Support
paras: 美國眾議院民主黨領袖Hakeem Jeffries公開支持彈劾國防部長赫格塞斯（Pete Hegseth），直言自己「堅定支持」這項提案。隨著美國期中選舉後，民主黨與部分共和黨議員相繼表態支持，要求赫格塞斯下台的聲浪持續升高，相關彈劾案最快可能於本周提出。
根據《彭博》報導，Jeffries周日（8日）接受《ABC》節目訪問時表示，赫格塞斯濫用職權、削弱美國國家安全，並一手促成魯莽且代價高昂的伊朗戰爭，不僅推升美國民眾的生活成本，也讓美國面臨更大的安全風險。
他指出，眾議院民主黨議員預計周二（10日）首次集會，屆時將討論是否提出彈劾決議案。這也是民主黨在期中選舉拿下國會參眾兩院多數席次後，首次召開會議。
自期中選舉以來，要求赫格塞斯下台的行動在民主、共和兩黨間逐漸升溫。赫格塞斯支持的對伊朗戰爭，也成為共和黨11月3日期中選舉遭遇全面性挫敗的原因之一。
肯塔基州共和黨眾議員Thomas Massie上周表示，眾議院復會後，他「肯定」會重新提出彈劾條款。
Massie在初選中敗給一名獲美國總統川普支持的挑戰者，將因此離開國會。身為川普的長期批評者，Massie曾在對伊朗衝突爆發之初，因赫格塞斯未經國會批准便發動對伊朗戰爭，試圖推動彈劾。
川普曾表示，目前沒有撤換赫格塞斯的計畫，並稱這名國防部長表現「不錯」。
川普周日再次公開肯定赫格塞斯的表現，向佛羅里達州記者表示，赫格塞斯在美國「基本上贏得兩場戰爭」的過程中扮演關鍵角色，所指包括對伊朗的戰爭，以及美軍推翻委內瑞拉總統馬杜洛（Nicolas Maduro）的軍事行動。
川普質疑，既然赫格塞斯是促成這些成果的重要人物之一，為何還有人想彈劾他。
Massie周四暗示，川普應盡快解職赫格塞斯，讓由共和黨掌控的參議院能在民主黨明年1月接掌控制權之前，確認繼任人選。
Jeffries則認為，這項彈劾決議案將獲得「極為強大的支持」，並再次強調：「赫格塞斯必須下台。」
來自阿肯色州的共和黨眾議員French Hill表示，是否撤換赫格塞斯，應由川普決定。
Hill指出，如果赫格塞斯未能妥善執行職務，川普就應考慮更換人選，但他也強調，五角大廈的領導方式是否適當，與赫格塞斯是否犯下足以構成彈劾的違法行為，是兩個截然不同的問題。

paras_en: The Democratic leader of the U.S. House, Hakeem Jeffries, publicly endorsed the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, stating he was "firmly supportive" of the proposal. Following the midterm elections, Democrats and some Republicans have voiced support, raising calls for Hegseth’s resignation, and the impeachment bill could be introduced as early as this week.

According to Bloomberg, Jeffries said on Sunday (the 8th) during an ABC interview that Hegseth abused his authority, weakened U.S. national security, and single-handedly drove the reckless and costly war against Iran, which not only raised the cost of living for Americans but also exposed the country to greater security risks.

He noted that House Democrats plan to hold their first meeting on Tuesday (the 10th) to discuss whether to file an impeachment resolution. This is the first meeting since the Democrats took a majority in both chambers of Congress in the midterms.

Since the midterms, pressure to remove Hegseth has intensified across both parties. Hegseth’s support for the Iran war has also been cited as one of the reasons for the Republican Party’s comprehensive defeat on November 3 during the midterm elections.
Kentucky Republican Representative Thomas Massie said last week that after the House reconvenes, he would "certainly" reintroduce impeachment provisions.

Massie lost a primary to a challenger backed by President Trump and will therefore leave Congress. As a long‑time critic of Trump, Massie had previously tried to push for impeachment when Hegseth launched the Iran war without congressional approval.
Trump has said there are currently no plans to replace Hegseth and has described the defense secretary as having performed "well."

On Sunday, Trump again publicly praised Hegseth’s performance, telling a Florida reporter that Hegseth played a key role in the U.S. "basically winning two wars," referring to the war against Iran and the U.S. military action that overthrew Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.
Trump questioned why, given Hegseth’s role in achieving these outcomes, anyone would want to impeach him.

Massie hinted on Thursday that Trump should remove Hegseth as soon as possible, so that the Republican‑controlled Senate can confirm a successor before the Democrats take control in January next year.
Jeffries believes the impeachment resolution will receive "extremely strong support" and reiterated, "Hegseth must step down."
Arkansas Republican Representative French Hill said whether Hegseth should be removed should be decided by Trump.

Hill pointed out that if Hegseth fails to perform his duties properly, Trump should consider a replacement, but he also stressed that whether Pentagon leadership is appropriate and whether Hegseth has committed wrongdoing sufficient for impeachment are two distinct issues.

items.title: 3.5萬個外掛助攻！DeepSeek AI代理不到3個月衝上154萬日活躍用戶
items.title_en: 3.5 Thousand Plugins Power DeepSeek AI, Surging to 1.54 Million Daily Active Users in Less Than Three Months
paras: 中國 AI 新創 DeepSeek 公布旗下 AI 代理基礎設施的亮眼使用數據，持續透過圍繞開源 AI 技術打造的各類應用程式，挑戰 Anthropic 與 OpenAI。
這家總部位於杭州的新創公司週日於 X 平台透露，旗下開源 AI 代理應用程式 DeepSeek Harness 自 8 月 13 日推出後，不到三個月，截至 11 月 4 日，日活躍用戶已達 154 萬人。
根據連接至自家伺服器的用戶數計算，9 月底、也就是桌面版應用程式推出不久後，日活躍用戶約為 27.1 萬人。
DeepSeek 去年以低成本推理模型 R1 震撼矽谷，如今正搶攻產業下一個戰場：AI 代理基礎設施，讓 AI 能代表使用者自主執行任務。
DeepSeek 計劃推出官方外掛市集，讓開發者發布外掛，供使用者搜尋探索。公司也規劃推出外掛開發者支援計畫，提供詞元（token）補助、技術協助及推廣機會，目前尚未公布進一步細節。
這些新動向反映 AI 產業的競爭重心正在轉移，業者爭取用戶愈來愈仰賴生態系與整合能力，而非僅靠模型效能。
DeepSeek 將 Harness 定位為開放、由開發者驅動的 AI 代理生態系，不僅要在模型效能與成本上挑戰 OpenAI 和 Anthropic，也要比拚圍繞其 AI 技術打造的應用廣度。
隨著 AI 產業從聊天機器人邁向自主代理，DeepSeek 押注第三方應用程式與專業工具能帶動旗下開源 AI 代理基礎設施的普及，並成為對抗矽谷專有技術的關鍵競爭優勢。
AI 代理能在極少的人為監督下，代表使用者執行多步驟任務，例如撰寫及修改程式碼、分析檔案、進行研究，以及使用其他工具。
Harness 的算力需求尤其值得關注。這款應用程式每日消耗約 92 兆個詞元，換算每名活躍用戶每日約使用 6,000 萬個詞元，成為首批顯示 AI 代理大幅推升算力需求的實際數據之一。
這項規模顯示，AI 代理的算力需求遠高於聊天機器人。AI 代理在幾乎無須人為介入的情況下，會連續運作數小時，讀取或撰寫程式碼、使用其他工具及瀏覽網路。
DeepSeek 正以「一切皆為外掛」的架構打造 Harness。外掛可在不更動軟體本身的情況下，為其增添特定功能。
DeepSeek 表示，目前約有 3.5 萬個外掛，且 60% 的用戶至少建立過一個外掛，不過各外掛的複雜程度不一。
paras_en: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has announced impressive usage data for its AI agent infrastructure, continuing to challenge Anthropic and OpenAI with a range of applications built around open‑source AI technology.

The Hangzhou‑based startup revealed on X that its open‑source AI agent app DeepSeek Harness, launched on August 13, had reached 1.54 million daily active users by November 4, less than three months after launch.
Based on the number of users connected to its own servers, the daily active user count was about 271,000 at the end of September, shortly after the desktop app was released.

DeepSeek shocked Silicon Valley last year with its low‑cost inference model R1, and is now targeting the next battleground: AI agent infrastructure that lets AI autonomously perform tasks on behalf of users.

The company plans to launch an official plugin marketplace where developers can publish plugins for users to discover and explore. It also intends to roll out a developer support program offering token subsidies, technical assistance and promotion opportunities, though further details have not yet been disclosed.
These new moves reflect a shift in the AI industry's competitive focus, with firms vying for users who increasingly rely on ecosystems and integration capabilities rather than just model performance.

DeepSeek positions Harness as an open, developer‑driven AI agent ecosystem that not only competes with OpenAI and Anthropic on model performance and cost but also outpaces the breadth of applications built around its AI technology.

As the AI industry moves from chatbots to autonomous agents, DeepSeek bets that third‑party apps and professional tools will drive adoption of its open‑source AI agent infrastructure and become a key competitive advantage against proprietary Silicon Valley tech.
AI agents can perform multi‑step tasks on behalf of users with minimal human supervision, such as writing and editing code, analyzing files, conducting research, and using other tools.

The compute demand of Harness is particularly noteworthy. The app consumes about 92 trillion tokens per day, which translates to roughly 60 million tokens per active user per day, making it one of the first real data points showing how AI agents dramatically increase compute demand.

This scale demonstrates that AI agents require far more compute than chatbots. With almost no human intervention, AI agents run continuously for hours, reading or writing code, using other tools, and browsing the web.
DeepSeek is building Harness around a "everything is a plugin" architecture. Plugins can add specific functionality without modifying the core software.
DeepSeek reports that there are currently about 35 000 plugins, and 60 % of users have created at least one plugin, though the complexity of each plugin varies.

items.title: SpaceX星艦第15次試飛拚雙級回收26顆V3衛星擴大Starlink容量
items.title_en: SpaceX Starship 15th Test Flight Aims for Dual-Level Recovery of 26 V3 Satellites to Expand Starlink Capacity
paras: 2026年11月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX公布星艦第15次試飛計畫，最快於美國中部時間11月13日下午4時45分、台北時間11月14日上午6時45分發射，發射窗口為75分鐘，仍待監管機關核准。此次除將部署26顆Starlink V3衛星，也將首度嘗試讓上層飛船與Super Heavy助推器都返回發射場，由發射塔機械臂捕捉回收。
繼前次完成入軌與衛星部署後，這次試飛重點將延伸至上下級回收。依SpaceX規劃，上層飛船將進入約275公里高的軌道，繞行地球約14圈、停留超過22小時後返回；Super Heavy則會先行返回發射場，挑戰第三代助推器首次塔架回收，為後續快速重複使用累積測試經驗。
衛星部署方面，SpaceX表示，每顆Starlink V3衛星可增加1 Tbps網路容量，此次26顆衛星合計新增容量，約相當於獵鷹9號發射10次、搭載Starlink V2 Mini衛星所能提供的容量。對Starlink而言，星艦單次運載能力將是擴充衛星網路的重要測試。
不過，上層飛船能否返回發射場，仍須視飛行狀況決定。SpaceX將透過其中3顆搭載攝影機的衛星，觀察飛船隔熱層狀況，並檢查飛行期間各項關鍵系統；確認符合安全條件後，才會執行返回發射場的再入與塔架捕捉程序。
26顆衛星部署後，還須展開天線與太陽能板、建立通訊連結並提升軌道。SpaceX預期，完成相關檢查後，最快可在發射後數週內開始服務用戶。

paras_en: SpaceX announced its 15th Starship test flight plan, slated to launch at 4:45 p.m. Central Time on November 13 (6:45 a.m. Taipei Time on November 14) with a 75‑minute window, pending regulatory approval. The flight will deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites and, for the first time, attempt to recover both the upper stage and the Super Heavy booster at the launch site using the tower’s robotic arm.

After the previous flight successfully reached orbit and deployed satellites, this test will focus on recovering both upper and lower stages. According to SpaceX, the upper stage will reach an orbit of about 275 km, circle the Earth roughly 14 times, stay above 22 hours, and then return; the Super Heavy booster will first return to the launch site, attempting a third‑generation booster’s first tower‑based recovery to build experience for rapid reuse.

Regarding satellite deployment, SpaceX said each Starlink V3 satellite adds 1 Tbps of network capacity. The 26 satellites together add a capacity roughly equivalent to ten Falcon 9 launches carrying Starlink V2 Mini satellites. For Starlink, the Starship’s single‑flight payload capacity is a key test for expanding the satellite network.

However, whether the upper stage can return to the launch site depends on flight conditions. SpaceX will use three of the deployed satellites equipped with cameras to monitor the heat‑shield condition and check key systems during flight; only if safety criteria are met will it proceed with re‑entry and tower capture.

After deploying the 26 satellites, the upper stage must also deploy antennas and solar panels, establish communications, and raise its orbit. SpaceX expects that, after completing these checks, service could begin for users within weeks of launch.

items.title_en: NVIDIA Board Launches Independent Investigation, Asserts No Reason to Claim Confidentiality Breach
paras: 2026年11月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)董事會宣布，針對近期媒體報導創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳可能成為外國情報行動目標一事，啟動獨立調查。董事會表示，目前沒有理由認定美國國家安全或公司機密受到損害，但將檢視所有可取得的資訊。
調查將由獨立董事組成的委員會監督，並由外部獨立法律顧問協助。董事會表示，黃仁勳完全支持這項審查，並承諾配合調查。
董事會同時表達對黃仁勳及其領導團隊的信心，並表示將在適當時候提供進一步消息。聲明未公布調查完成時程，也未對相關媒體報導中的指控作出認定。
美國國會也已要求公司說明。眾議院外交事務委員會、中國問題特別委員會及情報委員會三位主席聯名致函黃仁勳，要求出席聯合閉門簡報，說明輝達防範外國間諜活動的安全措施，以及與媒體報導所涉人士的互動。

paras_en: On November 9, 2026, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced that its board has initiated an independent investigation into recent media reports alleging that founder and CEO Jensen Huang may have become a target of foreign intelligence operations. The board stated that there is currently no reason to conclude that U.S. national security or company secrets have been compromised, but it will review all available information.

The investigation will be overseen by a committee composed of independent directors and assisted by external independent legal counsel. The board said Huang fully supports the review and has pledged to cooperate with the investigation.

The board also expressed confidence in Huang and his leadership team, and said it would provide further updates at an appropriate time. The statement did not disclose a timetable for the investigation’s completion, nor did it address the allegations in the media reports.

The U.S. Congress has also requested the company to explain. The chairs of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, the China Subcommittee, and the Intelligence Committee jointly wrote to Huang, requesting his attendance at a closed-door briefing to explain NVIDIA’s measures to counter foreign espionage activities and his interactions with individuals mentioned in the media reports.

items.title: 中國PPI升至5.7%、CPI降至0.7%成本上漲與內需疲弱並存
items.title_en: China PPI Rises to 5.7%, CPI Falls to 0.7%: Cost Increases and Weak Domestic Demand Coexist
paras: 2026年11月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國國家統計局11月9日公布，10月生產者物價指數（PPI）年增5.7%，漲幅高於9月的5%，也超過市場預期的5.3%；消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率則由0.9%降至0.7%，低於預估的0.8%。兩項數據走勢分歧，反映中國企業面臨生產成本持續上升，但終端消費需求仍然疲弱的情況。
生產者物價漲幅擴大，主要受到油價及大宗商品價格上漲影響，但內需不足，使企業難以將增加的成本完全轉嫁給消費者。ING指出，能源及原物料價格持續推高生產端物價，消費端卻因需求疲弱，價格漲幅反而放緩。
值得注意的是，10月工業生產者採購價格年增7.9%，明顯高於出廠價格的5.7%，代表企業採購原料的成本漲幅已超過產品售價漲幅。對加工製造業而言，如果原料持續漲價，卻無法同步提高產品售價，毛利率就可能受到壓縮，尤其是議價能力較弱、原物料成本占比較高的企業，面臨的獲利壓力可能更加明顯。

paras_en: On November 9, 2026, the National Bureau of Statistics of China released data showing that the Producer Price Index (PPI) for October rose 5.7% year‑on‑year, higher than September’s 5% and above the market expectation of 5.3%; the Consumer Price Index (CPI) fell to 0.7% from 0.9%, below the forecast of 0.8%. The divergent trends of the two indicators reflect that Chinese firms are facing rising production costs while end‑consumer demand remains weak.

The widening PPI increase is mainly driven by higher oil and commodity prices, but insufficient domestic demand makes it difficult for companies to fully pass the added costs onto consumers. ING noted that energy and raw material prices continue to push up production‑side prices, while the consumer side sees a slowdown in price growth due to weak demand.

Notably, October’s industrial purchasing price index rose 7.9% year‑on‑year, markedly higher than the 5.7% increase in factory‑gate prices, indicating that the cost of raw materials purchased by firms has outpaced the price increase of their products. For processing and manufacturing firms, if raw material prices keep rising without a corresponding rise in product prices, gross margins may be squeezed, especially for companies with weaker bargaining power and a higher proportion of raw material costs, which will face more pronounced profit pressure.
